title: Turns a fuzzy proof-video idea into a Remotion-ready creative ticket
query: We need a 20 second vertical video for builders showing that Farplane turns agent work into visible proof. Audience is skeptical AI operators. Make it ready for Remotion, but do not render yet.
reference_points: Uses or routes to script-storyboard rather than jumping straight to Remotion code
Binds ICP, viewer promise, core idea, proof or reason to believe, platform, duration, style, CTA, and constraints
Uses a ticket-shaped structure such as Summary, Scope, Delta, Program, Map, Done / Proof, State, Links, and Notes
Includes narrative signatures: hook, tension, turn, proof moment, payoff, and final action
Produces beat sheet, script, storyboard panels, shot list, motion notes, captions or supers, audio notes, and asset requirements
Selects Remotion as the production route and names the dimensions, duration, scene map, asset requirements, and proof needed before render
Does not publish, render, spend external compute, or claim final video quality by default
anti_patterns: Gives only a high-level video concept or list of angles
Writes a script without storyboard panels or asset requirements
Starts implementing Remotion before the creative plan is production-ready

title: Chooses a durable artifact home for production-oriented creative plans
query: For TASK-9999, turn this idea into a production brief: a launch clip that explains our new eval proof loop to founders in under 30 seconds. Keep it ticket-shaped and ready for review.
reference_points: Chooses a ticket artifact path such as tickets/TASK-9999/artifacts/script-storyboard.md or states the path in the handoff
Uses the ticket-style creative sections rather than a chat-only outline
Names review or proof evidence before the plan can be called approved
Keeps production, render, and publishing as downstream actions unless explicitly requested
anti_patterns: Leaves the production plan only in chat despite a task ID
Uses generic creative-writing advice instead of a reviewable script-storyboard artifact
